ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of the average growth rate of the urbanization level in four Western European countries, with two bars for each country. The legend shows that the diagonal-line bars represent 1980~1984, and the dotted bars represent 1984~1989; above the zero line on the horizontal axis indicates positive growth, and below the zero line indicates negative growth. Looking country by country, Austria was negative in 1980~1984 and positive in 1984~1989; Belgium was negative in 1980~1984 and positive in 1984~1989; Switzerland was negative in 1980~1984 and still slightly negative in 1984~1989; the United Kingdom was positive in 1980~1984 and also positive in 1984~1989. Then reason: The question stem states that reurbanization is the process in which, after counterurbanization occurs, the urban central area becomes urbanized again. Therefore, judging that 1984~1989 was in the reurbanization stage should be understood as counterurbanization having appeared previously in 1980~1984, that is, negative growth of the urbanization level, and then positive growth again in 1984~1989. The countries that meet the condition of “turning from negative to positive” are Austria and Belgium, a total of 2.

raw_record.original_question:
再城市化是指城市因发生逆城市化而衰败的城市中心区再度城市化的过程。下图显示西欧四个国家的城市化水平平均增长速度。

<image1>

图中1984~1989年处于再城市化阶段的国家有几个？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of the average growth rate of urbanization levels in four Western European countries, with two bars for each country. The legend shows that the diagonal-line bars represent 1980~1984, and the dotted bars represent 1984~1989; above the zero line on the horizontal axis indicates positive growth, and below the zero line indicates negative growth. Looking country by country, Austria was negative in 1980~1984 and positive in 1984~1989; Belgium was negative in 1980~1984 and positive in 1984~1989; Switzerland was negative in 1980~1984 and still slightly negative in 1984~1989; the United Kingdom was positive in 1980~1984 and also positive in 1984~1989.
Then reason: The question stem explains that re-urbanization is the process in which the urban central area urbanizes again after counter-urbanization occurs. Therefore, judging that 1984~1989 was in re-urbanization should be understood as counter-urbanization having appeared previously in 1980~1984, that is, negative growth in the urbanization level, while 1984~1989 returned to positive growth. The countries that fit "turning from negative to positive" are Austria and Belgium, 2 in total.
